name: Metamagic Rod, Tumultuous
body:
Price varies: lesser tumultuous metamagic rod 3,000 gp, tumultuous metamagic rod 11,000 gp, greater tumultuous metamagic rod 24,500 gp; Aura strong (no school) Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that scatter the targets as though using the Tumultuous Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: lesser tumultuous metamagic rod 1,500 gp; tumultuous metamagic rod 5,500 gp; greater tumultuous metamagic rod 12,250 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Tumultuous Spell
